question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) AS multi_line_orders, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::FLOAT AS share_multi_line_orders, AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS avg_ordered_units_one_line_orders, AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS avg_ordered_units_multi_line_orders, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0) AS no_line_orders FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'

action.answer: For 2025 recorded order dates, there were 4,359,773 orders. Of these, 3,052,089 had more than one item line, a share of 0.700057 (70.005686%) of all orders. Average ordered units per order were 1.219753 for orders with exactly one item line and 3.484769 for orders with multiple item lines. There were 0 orders recorded with no item line. Ordered units are quantities, not item-line counts.
